issues.t: cognito-idp: 6 net-new causes — AdminRespondToAuthChallenge skips the app-client SECRET_HASH check, three refusal messages/classes are emulator-authored, the pool's OpenID discovery document is not served, and the access
UpdateIdentityProvider's ResourceNotFoundException uses the DescribeIdentityProvider "for tenantId" wording instead of "in User Pool"

cognito-idp: 5 net-new causes — tokens are signed ES256, the iss claim is the bare emulator endpoint, REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH answers 501 for a disabled user, and two refresh-token refusal messages are wrong
cognito-idp: REOPENS — the CustomEmailSender trigger is now invoked but dies at module load, so UpdateUserAttributes is refused 400 UserLambdaValidationException instead of issuing a code (1 cause)
cognito-idp: 2 net-new causes — the pool's published JWK carries no RSA modulus so no issued token can be verified, and Service Quotas knows no cognito-idp quota catalog
cognito-idp: SetUserPoolMfaConfig refuses de-activating TOTP while MfaConfiguration=OPTIONAL, so the pool's MFA posture is one-way (InvalidParameterException instead of 200)
cognito-idp: user-pool MFA configuration cannot be turned back off — SetUserPoolMfaConfig refuses the write and GetUserPoolMfaConfig keeps reporting TOTP enabled
cognito-idp: three 400 precondition gates unenforced — SMS role trust and password-reset destination

cognito-idp: the CustomEmailSender Lambda trigger is never invoked by UpdateUserAttributes / GetUserAttributeVerificationCode, so no verification code is ever produced and the attribute-verification state machine is unre

App-client and resource-server list members are re-ordered instead of preserving the order the request supplied
cognito-idp: StartUserImportJob's already-started refusal message is emulator prose instead of AWS's '<JobId> is not in the created state.'
cognito-idp: 2 net-new causes — GetProvisionedLimit refuses the API_CATEGORY category UserResourceRead as unknown, and the user-pool replica lifecycle cannot be driven to completion
